author: SickProdigy
description: Audience-first interactive help that preserves Red command visibility and permission checks, with an owner-only sanitized command inventory export.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server-level help presentation settings and Discord role IDs for optional presentation groups. It does not store member activity or message content.
install_msg: AdvancedHelp is installed disabled and leaves Red's standard help active. A bot owner can opt into the interactive bare-help menu with [p]advancedhelpset enable, configure it with [p]advancedhelpset, and restore Red help with [p]advancedhelpset disable. Direct command and cog help continue through Red. Bot owners can export sanitized command metadata with [p]docsreport.
name: AdvancedHelp
short: Permission-aware interactive help organized by audience.
